================================================================================
addition
================================================================================

locals {
  x = 1 + 2
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))
              right: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit))))))))))

          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression

                  (identifier)))
              right: (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
negation
================================================================================

locals {
  x = !false
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (unary_operation
              operand: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (bool_lit))))))))))

================================================================================
arithmetic operators
================================================================================

locals {
  a = 10 * 2
  b = 10 / 2
  c = 10 % 3
  d = 10 - 2
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))
              right: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))))))
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))
              right: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))))))
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))
              right: (expression
                (literal_value
                  (numeric_lit)))))))
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (operation
            (binary_operation
              left: (expression
